source: Second-screen flag adjudication — owner ruling ('apply as recommended') on the 2026-07-16 review walkthrough; 5 of the 11 flags in methods/second-screen-2026-07-16.json taken up
note: Each taken-up candidate got the same two-pass treatment as the original 40: full-text (or fullest-obtainable) retrieval, eligibility per PRISMA-SEARCH-PROTOCOL-2026-07-13.md section 4, venue-integrity appraisal at the prisma-appraisal-2026-07-13.json standard, and an adversarial verification pass on any ADMIT. The 6 flags not taken up remain excluded and logged.

adjudicated.title: Stream-Based IP Flow Analysis
adjudicated.reason: Original E2 exclusion was an abstract-level misread: at full text the subject is the stream-processing platform layer evaluated as security-flow infrastructure (I2) with benchmark + campus deployment evidence (I3). Venue clean (IFIP/IEEE IM 2021, Xplore 9464011, dblp conf/im/CermakC21). Level B not A: Dissertation Digest track summarizing a 2020 thesis whose primary benchmark is NOMS 2016 — 2016-era measurements carried as historical suitability + workflow design, not current performance. ADMIT upheld by independent adversarial verification (all cited numbers re-verified at the IFIP DL full text).

adjudicated.title: AI-Powered Threat Detection and Response: ... Real-Time IDS Using Network Traffic Data
adjudicated.reason: E1 as written: RF+LSTM classifier evaluated on CICIDS2017/UNSW-NB15/KDD; the 4.2 ms / 12k req/s figures are model-serving performance, platform is plumbing. Also IEEE-paywalled, numbers unverifiable at source. Consistency pair resolved: the included sibling (W2994134668) has the pipeline as its titled subject.

adjudicated.title: BigFlow-NIDS: A large-scale dataset for network intrusion detection in big data environment
adjudicated.reason: Governing criterion corrected from E2 to I2-fails: a Data in Brief dataset paper (legitimate Elsevier venue) whose subject is a merged NetFlow corpus for ML research; the flagged ~34x figure is a single-environment Colab load-time comparison (CSV 920.82 s vs Parquet 27.35 s) reported incidentally in the dataset description, not an architecture evaluation. Admitting it would break the same strictness that excludes the E1 classifier papers. Workflow appraiser was safety-blocked; adjudicated inline by the orchestrator under the same instrument, 2026-07-16.

adjudicated.title: Intrusion Detection in Industrial Networks via Data Streaming
adjudicated.reason: I3 confirmed at full text (E3 secondary): Springer Industrial IoT book chapter with no measurement, benchmark, deployment, or design evaluation of its own — all architectural content reproduced from cited work.

adjudicated.title: Data Warehouse Design for Security Applications Using Distributed Ontology-Based Knowledge Representation
adjudicated.reason: I2 fails on abstract evidence (was title-only): the 'warehouse' is a description-logic knowledge base for registering railway-infrastructure incidents, not telemetry/log storage-query-ingest architecture; I3 fails independently.
